description_en: Queries the monitoring information of an ECS instance. Queryable metrics include vCPU usage, burstable instance credits, inbound data traffic, outbound data traffic, and average bandwidth
description_zh: 调用DescribeInstanceMonitorData查询一台ECS实例的监控信息。可查询的指标包括ECS实例的vCPU使用率、突发性能实例积分、接收的数据流量、发送的数据流量、平均带宽等
name: DescribeInstanceMonitorData

parameters.description_en: The instance ID of the instance to query.
parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance to query
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of seconds (`ss`) is not `00`, the time is automatically rounded up to the next minute.
parameters.description_zh: 获取数据的起始时间点。按照[ISO 8601](~~25696~~)标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如果指定的秒（`ss`）不是`00`，则自动换算为下一分钟。
parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. - 600.
- 3600.
